testcase.name: Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 1: Verify that Title, Due Date, Staff, Task Status, and Task Type are mandatory fields in the "Create New Task" popup.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 2: Verify that a dropdown list opens when clicking on Task Type field.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 3: Verify that a dropdown list opens when clicking on Task Status field.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 4: Verify that selecting "Lead Management" from Task Type triggers the Lead Name dropdown in the task form.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 5: Verify that a task is created for the selected lead when lead Name is selected from the dropdown.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 6: Verify that selecting a module shows a relevant dropdown list for that module (e.g., Contacts, Properties, Projects).
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 7: Verify that selecting a contact from the dropdown creates a task linked to that contact.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 8: Verify that the contact tag is displayed correctly in the task form.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 9: Verify that selecting the "Property" module shows a dropdown list for selecting a property.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 10: Verify that the contact form displays correctly when opening or creating a contact from a task.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 11: Verify that selecting a property from the dropdown creates a task linked to that property.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 12: Verify that after creating a task, the associated property is correctly shown when the task is opened
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 13: Verify that a task created for a specific property is only visible within that property and the task module
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 14: Verify that selecting the "Project" module shows a dropdown list for selecting a project.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 15: Verify that selecting a project from the dropdown creates a task linked to that project.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 16: Verify that selecting the "Listing" module shows a dropdown list for selecting a listing.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 17: Verify that selecting a listing from the dropdown creates a task linked to that listing.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 18: Verify that after creating a task, the associated listing is correctly shown when the task is opened
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 19: Verify that a task created for a specific listing is only visible within that listing and the task module
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 20: Verify that recurring task checkbox shows a dropdown with "Weekly," "Monthly," and "Yearly" options.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 21: Verify that selecting "Weekly" from the recurring task dropdown sends email/notifications weekly.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 22: Verify that clicking "Sync Calendar" allows selection of a time period for task reminders.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 23: Verify that setting a reminder time sends an email or notification at the selected interval.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 24: Verify that syncing the calendar with selected days sends email/notifications for the chosen period.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 25: Verify that selecting a team from the dropdown shows the task to all users in that team.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 26: Verify that users added to the selected team can view the task.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 27: Verify that when a comment is added in the "Additional Comments" section, a notification is sent to the selected staff member.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 28: Verify that the added comment appears below the "Additional Comments" section once the task is saved.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 29: Verify that after adding a file and saving the task, the file appears only once even if "Save" is clicked twice
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 30: Verify that the added file appears correctly after saving the task.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 31: Verify that after creating a task, the "Create Sub Task" option becomes visible.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 32: Verify that clicking on the "Create Sub Task" button shows a field below the staff section to enter a sub task title.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 33: Verify that entering a title in the sub task field and saving creates the sub task.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 34: Verify that the sub task is visible within the parent task after creation.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 35: Verify that when the sub task is opened, a parent task dropdown is shown next to the team field.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 36: Verify that selecting a different parent task from the parent task dropdown updates the sub task’s parent task.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 37: Verify that all fields of the original task are copied correctly to the new task when the "Copy Task" option is used.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 38: Verify that changes to the original task do not affect the copied task after it has been created.
Contacts side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 39: Verify that the task is visible in the task list after it is saved.
